semantics.test_rule: Exact source/target boundary pair is explicit.
semantics.expected_rule: Unauthorized cross-boundary read/write/lifecycle action must fail.
semantics.relation_rule: Only explicit relation/delegation/sharing semantics may allow crossing.
semantics.side_effect_rule: Denied escape attempt produces no protected effect.
semantics.authority_rule: Test harness cannot hold hidden all-boundary bypass rights.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: same module type shares instance state
